specs.title: SCN-001: The trainee signs in to the Secure Area

steps.title: Given I am on the Login page
When I sign in with the training account
Then I am on the Secure Area with the heading "Secure Area"
And I see "You logged into a secure area!"

specs.title: SCN-002.1: Wrong credentials are refused with a specific message (an unknown username)

steps.title: Given I am on the Login page
When I sign in with an unknown username
Then I see "Your username is invalid!"
And I am still on the Login page

specs.title: SCN-002.2: Wrong credentials are refused with a specific message (the trainee with a wrong password)

steps.title: Given I am on the Login page
When I sign in with the trainee with a wrong password
Then I see "Your password is invalid!"
And I am still on the Login page

specs.title: SCN-006: The dropdown offers the documented options

steps.title: Given I am on the Dropdown page
Then the options are "Please select an option", "Option 1" and "Option 2"
And "Please select an option" is preselected and cannot be selected
When I choose "Option 2"
Then "Option 2" is the selected option

specs.title: SCN-007: Dynamically loaded content appears within 10 seconds

steps.title: Given I am on Dynamic Loading example 2
When I press "Start"
Then "Hello World!" is rendered within 10 seconds

specs.title: SCN-008.1: JavaScript dialogs report the user's choice (alert)

steps.title: Given I am on the JavaScript Alerts page
When I accept the JS alert
Then I see "You successfully clicked an alert"

specs.title: SCN-008.2: JavaScript dialogs report the user's choice (confirm)

steps.title: Given I am on the JavaScript Alerts page
When I dismiss the JS confirm
Then I see "You clicked: Cancel"

specs.title: SCN-008.3: JavaScript dialogs report the user's choice (prompt)

steps.title: Given I am on the JavaScript Alerts page
When I accept the JS prompt
Then I see "You entered: held out"

specs.title: SCN-009: One click on "Last Name" sorts the first table ascending

steps.title: Given I am on the Data Tables page
When I click the "Last Name" header of the first table once
Then its rows are sorted by last name, ascending

specs.title: SCN-010: Elements are added and removed one at a time

steps.title: Given I am on the Add/Remove Elements page
When I press "Add Element" 3 times
Then there are 3 "Delete" buttons
When I press one "Delete" button
Then there are 2 "Delete" buttons
Given I am on the Key Presses page
When I press Tab in the input
Then I see "You entered: TAB"
Given I am on the Key Presses page
When I press A in the input
Then I see "You entered: A"
